s.how: Arrange 150g beef jerky, 200g mixed nuts and 200g cheddar on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Cut 1 bunch celery into sticks. Mix 100g blue cheese with 150g sour cream for the dip. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Season 4 rib eye steaks and grill 4 minutes a side. Serve with 500g frozen onion rings baked crisp. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate into 300ml hot cream with 2 tbsp sugar. Pour into 4 cups and chill 2 hours. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager and serve. Ginger beer for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
